heading: Parks Commission Reviews Scope of 2026 Improvements
category: Sun Prairie Parks, Recreation and Forestry Commission
source: Parks, Recreation and Forestry Commission video · 0:18:55–0:37:31
summary: Staff outlined proposed park improvements and plans to seek bids. Work discussed included rebuilding the Evergreen Park basketball court as a bid alternate. The timeline called for opening bids in August and reviewing a contract in September.
